```renyi
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal

  let rate be (100.00 - invoice.discount_percent) / 100.00
  let discounted be subtotal(invoice) * rate
  let cents be (discounted * 100.00).rounded()
  return cents.to_decimal() / 100.00
end
```

```renyi
public function total(invoice: Invoice) returns Decimal
  purpose: Subtotal after the percentage discount, rounded to cents.
  see also: subtotal
```

```renyi
  let before_discount be subtotal(invoice)
  let discount_rate be invoice.discount_percent / 100.00
  let discount be before_discount * discount_rate
  let discounted be before_discount - discount
  let cents be discounted * 100.00
  let rounded_cents be cents.rounded()
  return rounded_cents.to_decimal() / 100.00
end
```
